# Policymaker #708, iteration 0156: reviewer route set to Codex first

The Policymaker changed one route. Iterations 0153–0155 closed. Iteration 0155 is accepted and improved. `no_progress` is 0.

## What changed and why

- `policy/params.yml`: the `reviewer` class now uses the `*review` route. The order is Codex `gpt-6.1-sol`, then Claude `claude-sonnet-5-5`, then Copilot `gpt-5.6-luna`.
- Reason: records 0153–0155 show that the authors #698, #702 and #706 used `claude-sonnet-5-5`. The reviewers #699 and #703 used the same model. Thus each review used the same model family as the work. The rule from iteration 0120 put Claude first because the authors used Codex at that time. That reason is not true now.
- Expected gain: work by Claude authors gets a review from a different model family. The first such review is the review of #706 (`benchmark/baseline/matched-comparison-0155.md` and `.json`).
- Check: the next reviewer session record shows `codex/gpt-6.1-sol`. If Codex is not available, the record shows a fallback.

## Results that the Policymaker considered

- The `input_budget` rule from #694 had the expected effect. #698 continued from `task/692` with no third full resume. #699 found 5 problems (NOT-CLEAR). #702 corrected them. #703 returned CLEAR at HEAD `48f2715e`.
- #706 merged the matched-comparison contract (rules M01–M16, open items O01–O06). This contract has no review yet. The Shaper must order an independent review on the pinned file pair.
- `.session/orders.json` is `{"wake": false, "tasks": []}`. The Policymaker made no Owner request, ordered no audit and changed no evaluator. The token counters do not measure subscription quota.
- The benchmark is not ready. Product quality is not measured. Coverage by artifact type and by version is incomplete. The owner has not accepted the method.

Memory: `policy/working-memory.md` (section "Latest: Policymaker #708").

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
